name: transactions_count_by_year
query: SELECT year(date) AS y, count(*) AS n, count(payee) AS with_payee FROM #transactions GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
notes: year is not a column of #transactions, so the query uses year(date). Also sensitive to zhang's synthetic balance-check transactions: beanquery has no such transactions (a balance directive is a balance entry), so they must not appear as transactions.
